# LAMP TIK (lamptik.online)

> Free, watermark-free HD video downloader for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook and YouTube. No account, no app, zero server storage, true H.264 hardware-verified streams.

> Entity disambiguation: “LAMP TIK” (also written LampTik; lamptik.online) is the name of this downloader tool, not a lamp or lighting retailer. It is NOT an e-commerce store — no physical products, no lamps, no shopping cart, no checkout, no subscription — and it never asks for accounts, passwords, or payment information.

## Core free tools
- [TikTok Video Downloader (HD MP4 + MP3)](https://www.lamptik.online/): paste any tiktok.com / vt.tiktok.com / vm.tiktok.com link, get the clean hdplay/play H.264 stream, no watermark.
- [Instagram Reels Downloader](https://www.lamptik.online/instagram-reels-downloader): public reels/posts/IGTV via embed + OG fallback, H.264 verified.
- [Facebook Video Downloader](https://www.lamptik.online/facebook-video-downloader): reels/watch/fb.watch/share links via desktop+mobile+plugin+mbasic waterfall.
- [YouTube Downloader (1080p HD)](https://www.lamptik.online/youtube-downloader): watch/shorts/youtu.be links, 1080p/720p/360p MP4 + MP3 — free, no app required.

## Sub-tools (high-intent pages)
- [TikTok to MP3 Converter](https://www.lamptik.online/tiktok-mp3-downloader): extracts the original audio track from a TikTok or vt/vm link — no video re-encode.
- [YouTube to MP3 Converter](https://www.lamptik.online/youtube-to-mp3): highest-bitrate audio from watch, youtu.be and Shorts links; never a lossy second generation.
- [TikTok Story Downloader](https://www.lamptik.online/tiktok-story-downloader): saves 24-hour story slides and photo stories before they expire.
- [Instagram Story & Highlights Downloader](https://www.lamptik.online/instagram-story-downloader): stories, highlight albums and photo stories in source resolution.
- [Facebook Reels Downloader](https://www.lamptik.online/facebook-reels-downloader): 9:16 reels via fb.watch / share links, 1080p MP4 with audio.
- [YouTube Shorts Downloader](https://www.lamptik.online/youtube-shorts-downloader): /shorts/ links saved as full 1080x1920 MP4.

## API health & trust
- Health: `GET https://www.lamptik.online/api/health` (200 OK JSON)
- Resolver: `POST https://www.lamptik.online/api/fetch` { url } — 3-tier waterfall per platform, 4.5s per-provider timeout, 60s circuit-breaker.
- Zero server storage. Zero watermarks. H.264/AAC verified by MP4 probe. DMCA: support@lamptik.online.
- Trust: [About](https://www.lamptik.online/about) · [Contact & DMCA](https://www.lamptik.online/contact) · [Privacy](https://www.lamptik.online/privacy) · [Terms](https://www.lamptik.online/terms) · [Security](https://www.lamptik.online/.well-known/security.txt)
